changelog: Aura AI v2.1.9 — 60fps Smooth Chat Scrolling, Claude-Style Two-Row Composer & Clean Typography

Scroll Performance: Virtualized list with native 60fps fling physics, eliminated micro-item layout thrashing, fixed aspect-ratio image pre-reservations with full disk caching, and removed redundant spacers
Response Formatting: 1.5 line height, true hanging indent bullets & numbers, prominent bold headings, soft compact error cards, and 40dp action touch targets
Claude-Style Composer: Two-row card with full-width text input, auto-growing upward smoothly from 1 to 6 lines, and floating above the keyboard
